job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer to join our team at Micro1, with a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The ideal candidate will have experience working on complex projects involving natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive analytics.
Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop scalable data pipelines using big data technologies such as Hadoop and Spark.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale machine learning models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
Work on computer vision projects, including image and video analysis and generation.
Participate in the development of predictive analytics models to drive business growth.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.
Job Requirements
Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
